{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# Look for commas in the revenue strings
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Show sample of those with commas
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    print(f'Sample of revenue entries with commas: {df.loc[has_commas, "revenue"].head().tolist()}')"}
